perplexity.description:
Celebrate The Music Of Peter Green And The Early Years Of Fleetwood Mac is a live album by Mick Fleetwood, released in 2021 on the BMG label. It captures a February 2020 tribute concert at the London Palladium honoring Peter Green, the founding guitarist of Fleetwood Mac, who passed away shortly after the performance. The album features rock and blues-infused renditions of early Fleetwood Mac classics and related blues standards, showcasing the raw, roots-oriented sound that characterized the band's initial phase before their later pop-rock evolution.

This album holds a special place in Mick Fleetwood’s discography as his seventh solo project and a heartfelt homage to the band’s origins. It includes performances by notable guests such as Jeremy Spencer, an original Fleetwood Mac member, and Billy Gibbons, with Kirk Hammett guesting on guitar. The musical style leans heavily on blues-rock, reflecting Peter Green’s influence and the band’s early sound, distinct from the more polished, pop-oriented Fleetwood Mac era. The album was well received, charting in multiple countries including the UK, Germany, Australia, and the Netherlands, and was accompanied by a concert film broadcast in April 2020.

Overall, the album serves both as a historical document and a celebration of Peter Green’s legacy, emphasizing the blues roots and rock energy that defined Fleetwood Mac’s formative years. It stands out for its authentic live atmosphere and the collaborative spirit of Fleetwood and his friends revisiting seminal material with respect and reverence.

title: Celebrate The Music Of Peter Green And The Early Years Of Fleetwood Mac
